name: conflux-verifyflow
description: Conflux eSpace deploy & verify preflight — RPC, chainId, ConfluxScan lint

scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w @verifyflow/core && node web/scripts/copy-core-dist.mjs && npm run build -w @verifyflow/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=core && npm run dev -w @verifyflow/web
scripts.dev:stack: npm run build --workspace=core && npx concurrently -k "node scripts/local-api.mjs" "npm run dev -w @verifyflow/web"
scripts.preview:web: npm run build:vercel && npm run preview --workspace=web
